card.name: Second digit in coordinates and times
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the second digit of a number in geographic coordinates, clock times or measurements, such as the 9 in 49°30′N or the 0 in 00:06:05.

modes.label: Coordinates
modes.description: Second digit of a latitude or longitude value before degree marks or decimals.

modes.label: Clock times
modes.description: Second digit of an hour or time stamp, often after a leading 0.

modes.label: Sizes and lengths
modes.description: Second digit of a two-digit measurement before units.

card.plain: It fires on the second digit of two-digit numbers in map coordinates, times and measurements.
